proposal.title: Enable continuous experiment rotation for tied/unproven formats in engagement engine
proposal.reason: When all experiments have been tested at least once and engagement performance scores remain tied or zero during early baseline collection, max() previously defaulted permanently to Experiment A. Rotating across least-frequently and least-recently tested experiments when scores are tied guarantees balanced multi-format exploration across different market opportunities.
